big_case.notes: Formed before reading any candidate's big_case_score. A private election-integrity group's paid petition from a unanimous, fact-bound Seventh Circuit standing affirmance; respondents waived, no response was called for, one aligned amicus, considered once at the long conference and denied without noted dissent. The HAVA private-enforcement and organizational-standing questions have some national relevance, but this vehicle could not have reached them and drew no signal from the Court.

Result-capture coverage is 0.0 (an engine's standing shape), so every call is graded on its query: one caption search for the Seventh Circuit opinion and two chunk reads of it, plus local file reads of the provisioned record and statpack.
